prompt:
Based on the following database exploration, generate clarification questions for the human expert. Goal: Build a financial management data warehouse.

Table: orders
  Fields: id(BIGINT PK), amount(DECIMAL), status(VARCHAR), created_at(DATETIME), user_id(BIGINT)
  Row estimate: 500000

Table: products
  Fields: id(BIGINT PK), name(VARCHAR), price(DECIMAL)
  Row estimate: 5000

Relationship: orders.user_id -> users.id (unverified)

Generate up to 5 clarification items. Return JSON: {"clarifications": [{"question", "context", "candidates", "recommended", "recommended_reason", "impact_level", "blocking", "clarification_type"}]}
